title: Pirate: No Compromise Low-Bandwidth VR Streaming for Edge Devices
problem: High-quality VR streaming for edge devices requires simultaneously satisfying two competing demands: extremely low bandwidth (the edge uplink is constrained) and real-time rendering at high frame rates (90 FPS), while previous approaches sacrifice one for the other.
motivation: Edge platforms lack the compute and storage to render VR locally, making streaming the better paradigm, but existing ML-based stereo synthesis models are too computationally expensive for real-time use on resource-constrained edge devices.
method: Pirate sends only one eye's video at a time (alternating left and right), since the two views in VR are almost identical. Each transmission includes lightweight geometric information—disparity maps showing object distance and optical flow showing pixel motion—that let the device recreate the missing eye's view without large AI models, at bitrates as low as 0.1 bits per pixel. By alternating transmission, the system can also reuse frames recreated earlier, further saving bandwidth.
key_novelty: Reconstructing VR's missing eye view step-by-step using only distance and motion information (disparity and optical flow)—not large AI models—to enable 90 FPS streaming at 0.1 bits per pixel on edge devices.
contributions: Pirate framework exploiting stereo similarity for low-bandwidth VR streaming via single-eye transmission with alternating left/right schedule
Lightweight iterative stereo view synthesis using disparity and optical flow without ML model inference
Real-time operation at 90 FPS even at 0.1 bpp bandwidth constraint on edge hardware
20%–40% bandwidth reduction with similar quality compared to prior state-of-the-art streaming approaches

metrics.other: 20%–40% bandwidth reduction vs. prior approaches; similar quality maintained

limitations: Quality of synthesized stereo view may degrade under large disparity or fast motion; accuracy of optical flow on edge hardware under motion is not fully characterized.
primary_theme: Low-bandwidth real-time VR stereo streaming via stereo similarity exploitation
